# Hidden Roof

> A free first-person graffiti game in the browser. You climb onto the rooftops of a city drawn in ink, and the only color in it is the paint you bring.

There are no enemies and no goals: find your tools, paint whatever you like, scrub it off, paint again. Play alone, or bring friends into a multiplayer session and paint the same roof together.

- Play: https://roof.hidden.haus/
- Creator: GeoGeorgeous
- Free, in the browser: no account, no install.
- Needs a desktop browser with WebGL2, a keyboard and a mouse. Phones and tablets are not supported.
- Solo, or multiplayer: one player hosts a session and the others join it with its code.
- Inspired by Bombing!!, Marc Ecko's Getting Up and Daisuke Tajima's Beyond the Lines.
